subject: FLA causal-conv micro parity is HOLD; do not loosen threshold post hoc
body: Lane B reviewed the committed fla_triton_full adapter/probe and the completed scratch result. Focused runtime/training/eval suite is 29/29 PASS. The micro parity result is correctly HOLD under its predeclared thresholds: forward, cached update output, and cache mutation all pass strongly; gradients remain very highly aligned (cosines ~0.999996-0.999997), but case1/case2 grad_weight and grad_bias hit max_abs 0.0625 > the declared 0.05 threshold. The hand-written BF16 references match current Qwen3.5 fallback semantics for this training path (depthwise causal conv + SiLU; cached update concat/copy/conv/SILU), so this is not obviously a reference-shape bug. Hostile disposition: do NOT promote fla_triton_full and do NOT relax 0.05 after observing the miss. If we revisit, define a new prospective test before running it—e.g. BF16 ULP/scale-aware gradient criterion and/or an FP32 control—to determine whether 0.0625 is expected quantization noise or a material gradient discrepancy. Keep seq_idx blocked. No weight training should use full FLA causal-conv yet.
